items.definition: A sweet tropical fruit with yellow-orange flesh and one large flattened stone.
A soft tropical fruit with orange flesh, black seeds, and an elongated shape.
A fragrant tropical fruit with edible seeds and pale or pink flesh.
A large tropical fruit with a fibrous husk, hard shell, and edible kernel.
A very large tropical fruit with a spiky rind and sweet yellow pods.
A small tropical fruit with translucent sweet flesh beneath a thin rough shell.
A round tropical fruit containing aromatic pulp and many edible seeds.
A brightly colored tropical fruit with scaly skin and speckled flesh.
A crisp, rounded fruit with firm flesh, a central core, and small seeds.
A round citrus fruit with fragrant peel and juicy segments.
A sweet fruit, often narrow at the top and wider near its base.
A soft stone fruit with fuzzy skin and fragrant, juicy flesh.
A smooth-skinned stone fruit with juicy flesh surrounding a hard pit.
A small, round fruit that grows in clusters and has thin skin.
A small, round stone fruit, often red, with a single hard pit.
A red, heart-shaped fruit with tiny seeds across its outer surface.
A bright yellow citrus fruit with strongly sour juice and aromatic peel.
A small, tart red fruit that grows on low shrubs in wetlands.
A soft, sweet fruit with many tiny seeds inside a thin skin.
A large, round fruit with green rind, watery red flesh, and dark seeds.
A round fruit whose tough skin encloses many juicy, jewel-like seeds.
A small, dark blue fruit with a dusty bloom and mild sweetness.
A round melon with netted skin and sweet orange flesh.
A small orange stone fruit with velvety skin and mildly tart flesh.
A tall tropical plant with a slender trunk and a crown of large leaves.
A tall tropical grass cultivated for its thick, sweet, juice-filled stalks.
A handheld cutting tool with a sharp blade and a protective handle.
A small kitchen implement used to remove thin outer layers from produce.
A flat, durable surface used to protect counters while preparing food.
An electric kitchen appliance that chops and mixes ingredients in a rotating container.
A thick, mildly sour food made by fermenting milk with beneficial bacteria.
A warm dish made by cooking rolled or crushed grains in liquid.
A large road vehicle designed to carry many passengers along regular routes.
A massive land animal with a trunk, broad ears, and long curved tusks.
An intelligent marine mammal with a streamlined body and a long rounded snout.
A flying insect with four broad, often brightly patterned wings.
A large musical instrument that produces notes when keys strike internal strings.
A padded seat designed for several people, commonly placed in a living room.
A hand tool with a heavy head used chiefly for driving nails.
A storm marked by lightning, thunder, and often heavy rain or strong winds.
